links.outcome: Postoperative complications (CCI>20, any medical complication) with AI-guided personalized pathways vs standard care
links.effect: CCI>20 incidence 19.1% vs 28.0%, adjusted OR 0.63 (95% CI 0.42-0.92; P=0.02); any medical complication 23.7% vs 37.3%, OR 0.53 (0.36-0.76; P<0.001).
links.quote: Results from the nonrandomized before/after cohort study showed an incidence proportion of the comprehensive complication index >20 of 19.1% in the personalized treatment group versus 28.0% in the standard-of-care group, adjusted odds ratio of 0.63 (95% confidence interval, 0.42-0.92; P = 0.02).

unlisted_practices: Risk-stratified personalized perioperative treatment pathways with intervention intensity scaled to predicted risk
Short-term health economic modeling of AI-guided care

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation of an AI risk prediction model tied to tiered personalized clinical interventions versus standard of care via a before/after study.
